snapshot.description:
This week's release slice of the portrait mode epic (@task-fmq4vk). Goal: land the orientation unlock and visual test harness so subsequent scene redesign work can be done with visual feedback.

In scope this sprint:
- @task-yaajdi — P1: unlock orientation in app.json + project.godot + index.html
- @task-5divuc — P2: UILayout.gd portrait zones + design token palette  
- @task-bwuozl — P6: Docker + Playwright visual harness

Out of scope (next sprint): actual scene redesigns (P3–P5).

Done = game loads in portrait on mobile without rotation, zones defined, visual tests capturing screenshots.
snapshot.title: Sprint: Portrait Mode Foundation (week of 2026-05-25)
